purpose: human per-cell Ulrich-subtype cosine projected onto mouse cells through the SAMap graph, by connectivity-weighted mean over cross-species neighbours
primitive: workflow/scripts/transfer_label_staining.project (verbatim); the existing pseudotime transfer uses the same function with source_mask=mouse
CAVEAT: DOUBLY DERIVED. The source is a per-cell generalisation of the published cluster-level cosine (query side centred against the all-cell mean, since one cell cannot be centred across its own columns), and the projection is a weighted mean over cross-species neighbours. These are NOT the published cosines and NOT mouse-native measurements. Mouse cells with no cross-species neighbour are NaN, not zero. Read Stro-1/2/3/4/6 as the projected floor.
